scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm run builder:build && pnpm run desktop:compile
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "pnpm run builder:dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
